notes: Section headings on every control panel now sit on their own bar, so a long panel is easier to scan mid-show. On a Box or BG layer the Fill style menu now says Gradient (linear) and Gradient (radial) rather than leaving you to guess which was which - same two gradients, clearer names. The video layer says it wants an .mp4 or .webm file, and tells you so if you paste a YouTube or Vimeo page address instead. On a Mac the update notice now offers the download that matches your machine, so an Intel Mac is no longer pointed at the Apple Silicon version.
